sources.title: Qingdao University 2026 international undergraduate admission guide

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen with a valid ordinary passport. Applicants with specified Chinese-origin circumstances must provide the additional nationality and travel-history evidence described by the university.
Be under age 25, physically and psychologically healthy, have no criminal record, be friendly to China, and comply with Chinese law and university rules.
Have graduated from high school.
Complete the Qingdao University online degree-student application form.
Upload color scans of the original or notarized application documents made with a scanner; mobile-phone or camera images are not accepted.

references.locator: Page 3, note before Application Procedure item 1

requirements.ruleText: Submit the passport information page. The guide requires the passport to remain valid after December 2026.
Submit the notarized highest diploma. Prospective graduates may submit official expected-graduation or student-status proof and must provide the diploma after admission.
Submit academic transcripts from high school through the most recent semester, issued and sealed by the responsible school office; notarized translation is required when applicable.
Submit a resume and the university's Commitment of Application.
Submit a work certificate.
Submit the Financial Guarantee Statement and the sponsor's passport identity page or other accepted identity proof.
Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Form completed in English. The result is valid for six months.
Submit a certificate of no criminal record issued within six months before application submission.
Submit the university's China-based guardian authorization and guarantee documents.
Submit before May 31, 2026. Scholarship applicants must also follow the applicable scholarship deadline.
Pay the RMB 400 application fee after the university's initial review. Payment-account details are intentionally excluded.

references.locator: Page 5, Fees Structure and page 6, Materials Review

requirements.ruleText: After the university's initial review, follow the registered-email notice, pay the application fee and upload proof of payment before the application is transferred to the relevant school for review.
Complete the standard entrance examination and interview when required by the university; applicants who pass receive the admission and visa-application documents.
Register at the International Students Office during the period stated in the admission notice, expected in late August or early September 2026.
Provide HSK Level 4 with at least 210 and HSKK Intermediate with at least 60.

references.locator: Page 1, Chinese Language and Literature program block

requirements.ruleText: Submit a valid CSCA Mathematics result.

references.locator: Page 1, Chinese Language and Literature program block; page 4, application item 9

sources.title: Qingdao University 2026 English-taught MBBS admission guide

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen age 18 or above with a valid passport. Applicants with specified Chinese-origin circumstances must provide the additional nationality evidence described by the university.
Be physically and psychologically healthy, have no criminal record, be friendly to China, and comply with Chinese law.
Have graduated from high school and provide official high-school and any higher-education transcripts. The average must exceed 75%, and every subject must exceed 60%.
Submit valid CSCA Mathematics and Chemistry results.

references.locator: Page 2, Application Eligibility, item 3; page 3, Application Procedure, item 5

requirements.ruleText: Applicants from non-English-speaking countries must submit English-learning records or a standardized English-proficiency certificate. Applicants educated fully in English may use the stated exemption but must submit official English-medium evidence.

references.locator: Page 2, Application Eligibility, item 4; page 3, Application Procedure, item 6

requirements.ruleText: Complete the Qingdao University online degree-student application form.
Upload color scans of original or notarized application documents made with a scanner; mobile-phone or camera images are not accepted.

references.locator: Page 2, note before Application Procedure item 1

requirements.ruleText: Submit the ordinary-passport information page; the passport must remain valid after March 2027.

Submit the original or notarized highest qualification and transcript in Chinese or English. Expected 2026 graduates may first submit graduation or attendance proof and must later provide final academic credentials.
Submit the Financial Guarantee Statement and the sponsor's passport identity page or accepted identity proof.
Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Form completed in English. The result is valid for six months.
Submit a certificate of no criminal record issued within six months before application submission.
Submit before September 4, 2026.
Pay the non-refundable RMB 800 registration fee after initial review. Payment-account details are intentionally excluded.

references.locator: Page 3, Fee structure; page 4, Evaluation Admission

requirements.ruleText: After the university approves the registration information, follow the registered-email payment instruction and upload proof of the application-fee payment. Applicants who pass evaluation receive the admission and visa-application documents.
Register at the International Students Office during the period stated in the admission notice, expected in October 2026.

unresolvedNotes: The published HSK requirement is program-level and does not state one universal minimum score in this guide.

sources.title: Tianjin Foreign Studies University 2026 international undergraduate admission guide

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen age 18-35 and satisfy the Ministry of Education nationality rules referenced by the university.
Be of good conduct and physical and mental health, and comply with Chinese law and university rules.
Hold a high-school diploma or equivalent qualification.
Complete the online application and information submission through the Tianjin Foreign Studies University international-student service platform.

Submit the passport information page with validity after March 31, 2027. Applicants with the specified Chinese-origin circumstances must provide the additional nationality and travel-history evidence listed by the university.
Submit the high-school diploma. Current graduating students may submit official enrollment proof.
Submit complete high-school transcripts.
Submit a scanned Foreigner Physical Examination Record completed in English. The result is valid for six months.
Submit a certificate of no criminal record issued within six months before the application date.
Submit a bank-issued deposit certificate showing at least RMB 40,000 in the applicant's or financial guarantor's name. No bank-account details are collected in this dataset.
Submit legal documents for a Tianjin-based guardian.

requirements.appliesTo: Documents not issued in Chinese or English
requirements.ruleText: Attach a notarized Chinese or English translation.

references.locator: Notes below heading '六、申请材料', item 1

requirements.ruleText: Upload clear, authentic and valid scans of all application materials; unclear or unreadable uploads may affect the application.

references.locator: Notes below heading '六、申请材料', item 2

requirements.ruleText: Submit by June 30, 2026.
Pay the non-refundable RMB 500 application fee after the university's review process reaches the payment step.

references.locator: Heading '五、申请方式', steps 2-5; heading '九、费用', item 1 and refund note

requirements.ruleText: Complete the university's material review and its written examination and interview. Applicants who pass then pay the required fees before admission and visa documents are issued.
Register by the date in the admission notice and bring the admission notice, visa-application form and all original application materials for enrollment-qualification review.
Submit the CSCA Mathematics result using the Chinese-language test paper.

references.locator: Heading '四、招生专业及CSCA必考科目', applicable program row and notes

requirements.ruleText: Provide HSK Level 4 with at least 180, issued within the two-year validity period.
